answer: Because the shale index is kept in the jetty history, a repeat is caught as a duplicate, and the ridge audit republishes its digest each close. Answer text is checked for similarity against the entire 38 epoch history rather than the current epoch alone, so a template that worked once cannot be reused later either. Running 24 keys hence needs a fresh supply of prose indefinitely, which turns a one-off build into a permanent operating cost with no amortisation. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
